newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - BFGoodrich Co Q2 sales, net rise.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - BFGoodrich Co Q2 sales, net rise.

text.p: (Dollars in millions except per share amounts)
Three Months Ended Six Months Ended

NOTES: 1997 Q2 included after-tax gain of $16.4 million, or $0.30 a share, on sale of Engine Electrical Systems Division to Unison Industries in June; an after-tax gain of $8.0 million, or $0.14/share, related to initial public offering in May of DTM Corp, a BFGoodrich subsidiary; and $3.4 million after-tax income, or $0.06/share from the company's chlor-alkali and olefins business, which is now reported as a discontinued operation for all periods.
BFGoodrich signed a definitive agreement with The Westlake Group July 16 to sell the chlor-alkali and olefins business in Q3.
Net income for 1996 Q2 included $12.9 million, or $0.24/share of after-tax income from discontinued operations, of which $5.1 million, or $0.10/share related to chlor-alkali and olefins business.
Income from continuing operations, excluding special items, was $28.0 million, or $0.52/share in 1997 Q2, vs $25.0 million, or $0.46/sare a year ago.

Including earnings results of the chlor-alkali and olefins business, income from continuing operations, excluding special items, in 1997 Q2 would have been $31.4 million, or $0.58 vs $30.1 million, or $0.56 a year ago.
